articles.headline: Messi tracker: Goals, assists, key moments in 2026
articles.description: ESPN provides game-by-game analysis of Lionel Messi's performances for Inter Miami and Argentina.

articles.headline: Six Arab federations back Infantino amid revolt over World Cup plan
articles.description: The heads of six Arab football federations expressed their "full support" and "confidence" in Gianni Infantino on Thursday as the embattled FIFA president fights to keep his job after his failed World Cup private investment plan.

articles.headline: 'This was my World Cup': How referee barred from U.S. made it to UEFA Super Cup
articles.description: Somali referee Omar Artan was denied entry to the U.S. for the World Cup, sparking a remarkable chain of events that led to him officiating the UEFA Super Cup.

articles.headline: CAF boss: Only elections can decide Gianni Infantino's FIFA future
articles.description: African football boss Patrice Motsepe has said that the position of embattled president Gianni Infantino can only be decided by FIFA elections.

articles.headline: Former FIFA Council member Isha Johansen says Gianni Infantino should step down 'for the good of football'
articles.description: Former FIFA Council member Isha Johansen has become the first prominent African football figure to publicly break with the wave of support for FIFA president Gianni Infantino from across the continent.

articles.headline: Netherlands hire Xavi as coach through 2030 World Cup
articles.description: The Netherlands have appointed Barcelona great Xavi Hernández as the national team's new coach following the resignation of Ronald Koeman after a disappointing FIFA World Cup.
